digest.component_or_area: quality audit remediation; CI, documentation, and code structure (structured_run, compact, event_append modules; graph traversal subsystem; attest package typing)
propositions: CI default-suite has a pytest-xdist teardown flake under host CPU/memory contention in test_opcert_service_app that causes benign post-results noise rather than build failure
User-facing documentation teaches an assignee example inconsistent with docs/config.md and Jira-resolvable identity requirements

Four near-cap modules (structured_run.py, compact.py, event_append.py, and graph traversal functions) mix responsibilities across layers and duplicate infrastructure, requiring decomposition by call-graph seams to reduce complexity and LOC below ratchet thresholds

Graph loader and traversal subsystem has duplicated BFS/loading logic across _blockers and _compute_dep_graph with high cyclomatic complexity in _find_direct_blockers, _get_all_blocked_by, check_cycle_at_level, and detect_newly_unblocked
attest package lacks type annotations required for mypy --disallow-untyped-defs compliance
Complexity and size ratchets prevent regression but enable creep toward caps; systemic early-warning margin at pre-cap thresholds is needed to surface violations before reaching enforcement limits
